feature: Prioritized change plan with a do-not-change set
problem: The gap assessment names keep, change, and undecided readings but does not say what a later cycle should edit, in what order, or what must stay.
proposed_solution: Write one sequenced plan that turns each change reading into a later-cycle edit, lists an explicit do-not-change set, and reconciles one early question with a shorter loop.

definitions.change_path: A repo path that appears as a change reading in docs/agent-guidance-gap-assessment.md.

acceptance_criteria: docs/agent-guidance-change-plan.md exists and contains exactly these level-2 headings in this order: Boundary, Do not change, Change, Sequence, Reconciliation. Boundary contains ### In scope and ### Out of scope. Out of scope explicitly excludes library edits to rules, skills, hooks, or harness artifacts, and excludes commits. git status --porcelain outside .harness/ shows this file and may show the two prior_docs paths, and no other path.

Do not change has at least 5 markdown list items. Each item contains a repo path in backticks that exists on disk, and the exact phrase do not change. At least one item is library/cursor/hooks.json. At least one item is library/cursor/rules/planning_discipline.mdc. At least one item is library/cursor/agents/planner.md.

Change has at least 4 and at most 6 markdown list items. Each item contains a repo path in backticks that is marked change in docs/agent-guidance-gap-assessment.md, and one sentence of at least 40 characters describing the later edit. The paths library/cursor/rules/autonomous_execution.mdc, library/cursor/skills/prompt-coaching/SKILL.md, library/cursor/hooks/harness-context.sh, and library/cursor/skills/adversarial-harness/SKILL.md each appear.

Sequence is an ordered list of at least 4 steps. Each step names a Change path in backticks. The section states that a later cycle implements the steps and that this document does not implement them. Step text says spike and docs tasks skip a separate evaluator subagent.

Reconciliation contains the exact phrase one question and states that an ambiguous goal gets that question before any edit, while an already-specified command does not. It states that the question is not followed by a coaching tip or a second round. It names both library/cursor/rules/autonomous_execution.mdc and library/cursor/skills/prompt-coaching/SKILL.md in backticks.
edge_cases: A do-not-change or change path that does not exist on disk fails the path criterion.

A Change path that the gap assessment marks only as keep, with no change reading, fails AC3. library/cursor/skills/adversarial-harness/SKILL.md is allowed because the gap assessment marks it both keep and change.
Sequence steps that tell the reader to edit files in this same session fail AC4.
Reconciliation that asks for a multi-question interview, or that tells the agent never to ask, fails AC5.
verification_method: 1) test -f docs/agent-guidance-change-plan.md. 2) rg '^## ' and assert the five headings in order. 3) rg Boundary subheadings and the library-edit exclusion plus commits exclusion. 4) git status --porcelain filtered outside .harness/: allow only the new plan and the two prior docs. 5) Parse Do not change items for backtick paths, test -e, phrase do not change, and the three required paths. 6) Parse Change items: count 4-6, test each path is a change reading in the gap assessment (line contains the path and the whole word change), and each item has a >=40-char sentence. 7) Parse Sequence as an ordered list of >=4 steps, each mentioning a Change path; rg for later cycle and does not implement; rg for spike and docs and evaluator. 8) Reconciliation: rg 'one question'; confirm ambiguous-before-edit vs specified-command; confirm no coaching tip or second round; confirm both required paths.
